evidence: They ran to the root bridge
far end still hung from the shoreward ledge
"We can't walk that," Nisa said.
brief_structural_obligations.comment: Both characters begin on the inland side of damaged root span

evidence: tied one end of their route line
passed the middle over the bough
clipped the other end to Nisa's harness
She ran three steps and jumped.
"Made it!" She unclipped
tied it off
brief_structural_obligations.comment: Line anchored and Nisa swings to lower shoreward ledge

evidence: Arda clipped his harness to the line
he jumped onto them and scrambled upward
The last bridge anchor groaned
brief_structural_obligations.comment: Arda follows on still-attached root bridge with guide line

evidence: root hooked the taut rope just ahead of his safety clip
the snag dragged the line downward
Its gate jammed tight against his harness
sliced the loaded stretch between his clip and the falling root
The wrenching pull vanished
brief_structural_obligations.comment: The snag and downward rope load happen before Arda cuts the loaded span

evidence: She dropped flat, seized his wrist
"Then give me your other hand!"
She dug her boots into the root and held him at the rim
brief_structural_obligations.comment: Nisa catches Arda before he gets to the far shore, protecting the emotional payoff

evidence: cut halves of their line dangled out of reach
brief_structural_obligations.comment: Useful route line sacrificed and unavailable for launch

editorial_revision_note: Clarifies far-bank knot, load-jammed carabiner, and severed but physically stranded line ends.
